manifest.name: Resellers
manifest.summary: Publish your resellers/partners and forward leads to them

models._description: Partner Level (inherits res.partner.grade from partnership + website.published.mixin)
Lead/Opportunity extended with partner assignment + geo-localization
Partner extended with level weight, activation, partnership/review dates, implementation refs

behavioral_notes.observation: Automatic geographic lead-to-reseller matching. assign_partner (called by action_assign_partner and the forward wizard) geo-localizes the lead via res.partner._geo_localize (street/zip/city/state/country -> partner_latitude/longitude), then search_geo_partner runs a cascade of progressively wider bounding-box searches in the SAME country (lat +/-2 lng +/-1.5, then +/-4/+/-3, then +/-8/+/-8 degrees), falling back to all-in-country, then a raw SQL nearest-neighbour query (point(lng,lat) <-> point) as a last resort. Eligible partners must have partner_weight>0 and not be in partner_declined_ids. The winner is chosen by random.choices weighted by partner_weight, so higher partner levels statistically win more leads. On a match it writes partner_assigned_id and _handle_salesmen_assignment to the partner's user_id; on no match it tags the lead tag_portal_lead_partner_unavailable. Pure code logic, invisible to metadata.

res.partner.grade is the partner-program 'Level' (defined in the partnership dependency); this module grafts website.published.mixin onto it (so a level is publishable on /partners) and adds partner_weight (default 1, 'gives the probability to assign a lead to this partner; 0 means no assignment'). res.partner.partner_weight is a stored compute copying grade_id.partner_weight, so a partner's grade drives BOTH its public-directory ranking (grade_sequence ASC) and its weighted contention for incoming leads. res.partner.activation + date_partnership / date_review / date_review_next track the partner-program lifecycle (activated, periodically reviewed). res.partner.grade._compute_website_url points each level at /partners/grade/<slug>.

The 'Forward to Partner' wizard is the manual hand-off path. forward_type='single' forwards selected leads to one manually chosen partner; forward_type='assigned' computes partners automatically via search_geo_partner using GPS + grades. action_forward validates each target partner has an email, then per partner renders email_template_lead_forward_mail with a portal deep-link (/my/<type>/<id>) and send_mail, writes partner_assigned_id + user_id onto the leads (mail_auto_subscribe_no_notify) and message_subscribe's the partner. Side effects: outbound emails to resellers, lead ownership reassignment, chatter subscription.

Portal-facing reseller workflow on an assigned lead, all gated by _assert_portal_write_access (the user's commercial_partner must be a parent of partner_assigned_id) and run sudo. partner_interested posts a message then convert_opportunity(partner_id) -> turns the forwarded lead into the reseller's opportunity. partner_desinterested clears partner_assigned_id, unsubscribes the partner, appends them to partner_declined_ids (so search_geo_partner skips them on re-assignment) and optionally tags spam. create_opp_portal lets a graded partner self-create an opportunity (requires grade_id), assigning it to their commercial_partner_id and converting it. update_lead_portal / update_stage_from_portal / update_contact_details_from_portal let the reseller edit revenue/probability/activities/stage/contact from the portal.

A read-only SQL view (no real table) joining res.partner against account.invoice.report (posted out_invoice/out_refund only) to expose, per partner: grade_id, activation, partnership/review dates, country (the first child contact with a country), nbr_opportunities (count of crm_lead where partner_assigned_id=partner) and turnover (invoice price_subtotal). It is the partner-program KPI/reporting surface measuring channel performance (opportunities forwarded vs invoiced turnover per reseller).

One public Interaction (CRMPartnerAssign, selector #wrapwrap) bound to the /partners + portal pages: it wires the 'I am interested' / 'not interested' confirm buttons (orm.call crm.lead.partner_interested / partner_desinterested), the opportunity stage buttons, the new-opportunity dialog (create_opp_portal) and the contact/opportunity edit forms, redirecting to /my/leads. Plus website_builder snippet options for the partner-directory page (partner_page_option) and a publish tour. No OWL components or backend patches; 4 asset bundles (web.assets_frontend, website.website_builder_assets, html_builder.assets_inside_builder_iframe, web.assets_tests).

it_architecture.application: website_crm_partner_assign (Resellers / partner-program lead-assignment component on top of crm + website)
information_flows: depends: crm (lead/opportunity), partnership (res.partner.grade levels), account (invoice turnover), base_geolocalize (geo), website_partner + website_google_map (public directory + map), portal
side-effect: crm.lead.assign_partner -> geo-localize + weighted-random partner match -> partner_assigned_id + salesman assignment
side-effect: crm.lead.forward.to.partner.action_forward -> outbound reseller email (portal link) + lead reassignment + subscription
side-effect: crm.lead.partner_interested -> convert_opportunity (lead becomes reseller opportunity); partner_desinterested -> declined_ids + unsubscribe
side-effect: res.partner.grade.write(partner_weight) -> res.partner.partner_weight recompute -> changes lead-assignment contention + directory rank
flow: res.partner.grade.website_published + partner.website_published -> public /partners directory listing

capabilities: Maintain Reseller/Partner Program (levels, weights, activation, review cadence)
Publish Partner Directory (public /partners listing by grade & country)
Partner Self-Service Portal (accept/decline lead, create & manage opportunity)
Channel Performance Analysis (opportunities & turnover per partner)
value_streams: Lead-to-reseller mediation: capture -> geo-localize -> weighted partner match -> forward (email + portal) -> partner accepts -> convert to opportunity -> won/turnover
Partner onboarding & publication: set level/grade + activation -> publish on /partners directory -> periodic review (date_review_next)
Decline/reroute loop: partner not interested -> partner_declined_ids -> re-assign to next eligible reseller
policies: 4 record rules: portal graded partner reads/writes only leads child_of its commercial partner; portal/public read only website_published grades; salesman report scoping (all vs personal/global)
_assert_portal_write_access: only a commercial partner that is parent of partner_assigned_id may edit the lead
partner_weight>0 eligibility + weighted-random selection governs which reseller gets a lead (0 = excluded)
directory visibility policy: is_company + grade_id set + website_published + grade.website_published + grade.active
stakeholders: Public website visitor (finds a local reseller)

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services (3.x channel / partner management - reseller program & lead distribution)
classification.rationale: This module is a value-network (Stabell & Fjeldstad): its core function is mediation - linking customers (inbound leads/opportunities) to a network of reseller/channel partners and linking those partners back to the vendor. The defining mechanics are network ones: a published partner directory (a mediating layer that lets parties find each other), geo-spatial matching of a lead to the nearest eligible partner, and weighted-random distribution where a partner's 'level' (grade / partner_weight) sets its share of the mediated flow. Value derives from the size and quality of the partner network and from the intermediation infrastructure (the /partners directory, the forward wizard, the partner portal), not from transforming inputs (chain) or solving a single client's problem (shop). It does not own the underlying sell - crm (shop) qualifies the lead and sale (chain) fulfils it - it sits between them as a partner-program mediation layer routing demand to third parties. It is a primary activity feeding APQC 3.0 Market and Sell (channel / partner management); the accepted lead converts to a partner opportunity and the channel report ties it to invoiced turnover.

standard_capabilities: partner levels (grades) with weight + activation states and review dates
public, SEO-sitemapped reseller directory at /partners filterable by grade, country, industry and free-text search, with Google Maps
automatic geo-localization of leads and weighted geographic assignment to the nearest eligible partner
manual 'Forward to Partner' wizard (single or auto/GPS) emailing resellers a portal link
partner portal to accept (convert to opportunity), decline (reroute), self-create and manage opportunities
CRM Partnership Analysis report (opportunities + turnover per partner)
typical_fits: vendor-with-reseller / channel sales model publishing 'find a partner' pages
tiered partner programs (Gold/Silver/Bronze levels) that should win leads proportionally to tier
geographic territory routing of inbound leads to local partners
letting partners self-serve their forwarded pipeline without backend access
common_gaps: assignment rules beyond geo + weighted-random (round-robin fairness, capacity caps, industry/skill routing)
partner-program governance: contracts, certification, commission/rebate accounting
richer partner scorecards / SLA tracking beyond opportunities + turnover
non-geographic or multi-criteria matching (the cascade is country-bounded and lat/long-driven)
geocoding backend choice/keys (base_geolocalize provider) and Google Maps API-key configuration
drive_hints: odoo shell: l = env['crm.lead'].search([('country_id','!=',False)], limit=1); l.assign_partner(); l.partner_assigned_id.display_name
curl http://localhost:8069/partners (auth=public) - render the reseller directory; /partners/grade/<id> to filter by level

open_questions: Which geocoding provider base_geolocalize uses at runtime (Nominatim / Google) and whether a Google Maps API key is configured for the directory map.
Real-world fairness of weighted-random geo assignment under volume and overlapping territories (no capacity cap is enforced in code).
Exact partner-program lifecycle automation (if any) driving date_review_next / activation transitions - none found as a cron in this module.
Interaction between the base crm lead-assignment cron (crm.ir_cron_crm_lead_assign) and this module's partner-assignment path.
